loading-subtitle: Scanning recent Neovim sessions and projects

command.description: The Neovim executable or frontend to use. GUI frontends should include `--` after the command, e.g. `nvim-qt --`.
command.label: Neovim command

max_results.description: Maximum number of recent projects to show in the launcher
max_results.label: Max Results

run_in_terminal.description: Whether to run the command in a terminal emulator. Should be enabled when using plain text-based nvim, and disabled when using a GUI frontend.
run_in_terminal.label: Run in terminal

terminal.description: Custom terminal command (leave empty to use Noctalia default)
terminal.label: Custom Terminal
